purpose: Demonstrate how the timing watchdog and telemetry report deadline pressure under a deterministic host load spike.
preconditions: Nominal timing profile is available for comparison.
Controller watchdog thresholds are left at the documented defaults.
No unrelated benchmark or package installation tasks are running on the host.

bench_extension.operator_action: Repeat on a PREEMPT_RT or real-time target and record scheduler, kernel, CPU isolation, and timer source.

operator_notes: This is not a performance brag profile; it is a visibility profile showing the controller reports stress instead of hiding it.
If hardware timing is later captured, keep host and hardware plots separate.
